cuts.reason: Hard cut from the static living-room two-shot straight to the black title/branding card, landing right after the punchline 'Oh, the trial version' so the joke is the last thing heard before the show's outro stamp appears.

pacing_notes: There is no internal cutting during the dialogue itself: the entire setup-and-punchline exchange (both characters, phones in hand, deadpan expressions) plays out in one uninterrupted ~12.2s static wide two-shot, letting the low-battery-people stone-faced delivery carry the joke without any reaction cutaways. Pacing is then resolved with a single abrupt hard cut into a much shorter ~1.4s outro/branding card, so the rhythm is essentially 'one long held shot, then one short tag' rather than a build of shrinking shot lengths.
